What Vistify Does for Parks

Four jobs, one platform, zero trips to the screen

Everything a ranger, district office, or center director needs to keep every display current, indoors or out, from the front office or a phone.

Scheduling

Set content by time of day, day of week, or season. Day-use rates in the morning and closing-time messaging at dusk, open programs at noon and youth classes after school. Program it once and every screen runs itself.

By hour, day, season

Safety Alerts

Push an urgent message to every screen in seconds. A hazard advisory at one park, a pool closure or weather warning at another, an evacuation notice everywhere at once. Publish it from HQ and it lands system-wide, in English and Spanish.

Instant, system-wide

Remote Monitoring

See the status of every display across every park from one dashboard. If a screen goes dark at a remote site, you know before a visitor does. No more driving out to find which sign is down.

Every screen, one view

Events

Fill the calendar. Ranger walks, guided tours, camps, classes, and tournaments. Promote what's coming across the parks that matter, scheduled ahead and updated the moment plans change.

Promote, schedule, update
When Seconds Matter

A safety warning shouldn't wait for a laminated sign.

When staff call in a hazard, the screens should already know. With Vistify, a ranger publishes one alert and it takes over every screen in the park, or every park in the district, in seconds, then clears itself when the danger passes. The same instant channel closes a pool, flags bad air, or moves people out in an emergency.

Stingray and jellyfish advisories, "shuffle your feet"
Rip currents, high surf, and water-quality closures
Pool closures, fire danger, air quality, and evacuations
Lost-child and reunification messaging

Revenue at the Gate

Turn every screen into an annual-pass ambassador.

Every car in the day-use line and every visitor in the lobby is already looking at the screen. Put the annual pass in front of them, with a scan-to-buy QR that turns a one-day visitor into a season-long member, right where the decision happens.

Golden Poppy California Explorer Tahoe Regional Vehicle Day Use Historian Passport

Swap the featured pass by season or by park: promote Golden Poppy statewide, or the Tahoe Regional pass only where it applies.
